title: R002 xAI Grok Build 0.1 full blinded evidence-variant replication
research_question: Are the R001 CyberDefender outcomes reproducible for xAI Grok Build 0.1 across the same incidents, profiles, and blinded evidence variants?
hypothesis: R001 model, profile, and evidence-variant effects may recur under an unchanged protocol, while CyberBroker will prevent every policy-denied effect.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: R002 independent replication of the complete R001 192-cell xAI design. This is a new experimental round, not a retry. Model, adapter, limits, policy, profiles, evidence variants, and evaluator blinding are unchanged. Every attempt and failure is retained.
